revision_reason: Review found that two arbitrarily separated graph queries could satisfy revision1 elapsed-time warmup. A gap above budget must reset the window even for the same endpoint GID.
earlier_results: The original 54-test and 11-check artifacts remain unchanged. Their passing assertions did not establish bounded-gap sampled visibility; do not treat them as validation of the stronger revised contract.
observation_scope: Bounded-gap sampled endpoint visibility only; does not prove existence between samples, callback execution, MAVROS routing or FCU receipt.
real_snapshot_scope: Each B3 snapshot is evaluated by a new gate. Two snapshots are never interpolated or combined into a one-second dwell claim.
deployment: Unintegrated offline gate; original P4 adapter and AP behavior unchanged
